status: PRE-REGISTERED — a prediction for OUR OWN composed model, before it is fully built/evaluated

model.name: ORACLE-1.5B
model.subtitle: Sigma-0 reliability-composed, 8GB-served
model.is: a composed serving SYSTEM over a ~1.5B base (NOT a new pretrained checkpoint)
built_today: honesty probe clears gate at 1.5B (measured, assoc AUROC 0.774)

HaluEval_confident_wrong_rate.note: base measured-shape ~0.4; ORACLE via probe-filter (AUROC .77-.98) + grounding; frontier calibrated but no activation audit

expected_calibration_error.note: ORACLE reports KNOWN+UNKNOWN envelope, never a bare scalar (anti-42); refuses to collapse

abstention_precision_on_unknowns.note: fraction of 'I don't know / pinned' that are genuinely unanswerable — the Oracle pin class

cost.reading: ORACLE is ~8x cheaper per correct answer than the frontier reference on this mixed workload while trailing it on raw capability — the reliability-per-dollar axis is the win, not pass@1.

the_two_axis_thesis.axis_A_reliability_per_dollar: ORACLE cost-per-correct 0.197 vs frontier 1.268 (~6.4x cheaper per correct answer)
the_two_axis_thesis.axis_B_honesty: ORACLE confident-wrong 0.11 vs frontier 0.28 vs base 0.42 — LEADS both; structurally unavailable to closed frontier models (no activation audit)
the_two_axis_thesis.what_ORACLE_does_NOT_claim: it does NOT beat the 70B frontier on raw pass@1 anywhere (loses MATH 0.58 vs 0.75, SWE 0.10 vs 0.55). Capability scales with parameters; ORACLE is 1.5B.

falsifiable_core.primary: ORACLE leads BOTH the frontier reference AND base on the honesty axis (confident-wrong, ECE, abstention) while costing <0.15x the frontier per query
falsifiable_core.capability_claim_is_modest: ORACLE > base on every capability row; ORACLE < frontier on every capability row — a small model does not out-capability a 40x-larger one
falsifiable_core.kill: if ORACLE's confident-wrong rate is NOT below the frontier's, the one owned advantage (white-box honesty) failed to materialize and the product thesis collapses to 'a cheaper, weaker model'

biggest_extrapolations: confident-wrong reduction from probe AUROC to end-to-end HaluEval score (probe precision != deployment filter precision)
frontier reference numbers are approx-public, re-verify
foldback contribution is simulation-only; the capability column inherits that risk
honesty_on_this_prediction.binding_open_input: real phi on weak-verification workloads (#2928); and the honesty probe surviving ternary serving (#2873) — if the probe dies at 1.58-bit, axis B on the 8GB box weakens to grounding-gates-only
